text_summary.body: On 10/X of Zedekiah's ninth year Nebuchadnezzar and his army encamped against Jerusalem and built siege works; the siege lasted until his eleventh year.

setting.body: No Babylonian chronicle survives for these years. Ezekiel 24:1–2 records the same day. Young (2004) dates the start to about January 589 on his reckoning; Wiseman (via Guzik) gives a siege of about a year and a half.

constraints.subject: evt_01M4V7CG4KQTQRM4HAE7P593V3
constraints.textual_assertion: In the ninth year of his reign, in the tenth month
assumptions: Zedekiah's ninth year counted from his installation in spring 597 by either Nisan or Tishri reckoning; margin 7–9 years after the start (operator).

competing_reconstructions.label: January 588 (siege about 18 months)
proponents: D. J. Wiseman (via Guzik): "about a year and a half"

commentary.paraphrase: Guzik gives the siege dates in Zedekiah's regnal years and quotes Wiseman that it lasted about a year and a half.
